title: Attio onboarding band
description: A pale-grey framed band: a blue badge, a long two-tone 40px statement and an outline button, centred on desktop and left-aligned on phones; below, a pinstripe band fading in toward a hairline and a wide white record card that rises out of a blur and is cut off by the section's foot (bleeding off the right edge on phones).
notes: the card is a media slot (1150×576, the bottom ~20% is cropped); empty, a white placeholder
